title: Java Beginner Mock Test 2
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for Java at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of JDK?

options.text: use a JDK to compile source before running bytecode
a JRE-only installation may not provide javac

questions.explanation: use a JDK to compile source before running bytecode. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of bytecode?

options.text: recompile source after changes before running
editing a class file is not a source workflow

questions.explanation: recompile source after changes before running. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of main method?

options.text: declare the exact entry-point signature in an executable class
a misspelled signature is not selected as the entry point

questions.explanation: declare the exact entry-point signature in an executable class. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of primitive types?

options.text: choose types according to range and operation semantics
double is approximate and unsuitable for exact currency rules

questions.explanation: choose types according to range and operation semantics. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of integer division?

options.text: cast an operand before division when a fraction is required
casting only after integer division cannot restore the fraction

questions.explanation: cast an operand before division when a fraction is required. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of String equality?

options.text: use constant.equals(value) when value may be null
== compares object references rather than String content

questions.explanation: use constant.equals(value) when value may be null. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of parsing?

options.text: catch NumberFormatException only where recovery is defined
parseInt does not accept arbitrary decimal text

questions.explanation: catch NumberFormatException only where recovery is defined. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of short circuit logic?

options.text: place safety checks before dependent expressions
using non-short-circuit operators can evaluate unsafe expressions

questions.explanation: place safety checks before dependent expressions. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of if chains?

options.text: separate if statements can execute overlapping branches

questions.explanation: order mutually exclusive boundaries intentionally. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of switch?

options.text: handle every allowed category or provide an intentional default
switch does not replace range-oriented conditions cleanly

questions.explanation: handle every allowed category or provide an intentional default. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of arrays?

options.text: use length minus one as the final valid index
access at index length throws an exception

questions.explanation: use length minus one as the final valid index. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of enhanced for?

options.text: use it when position is irrelevant
assigning the loop variable does not replace an array element

questions.explanation: use it when position is irrelevant. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of while loops?

options.text: update termination state on each normal path
missing progress can produce an infinite loop

questions.explanation: update termination state on each normal path. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of methods?

options.text: return calculated data instead of only printing it
a void method cannot provide a result expression

questions.explanation: return calculated data instead of only printing it. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of pass by value?

options.text: remember that a copied object reference can still reach shared mutable state
reassigning a parameter does not reassign the caller variable

questions.explanation: remember that a copied object reference can still reach shared mutable state. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of encapsulation?

options.text: validate inputs in constructors and mutation methods
public mutable fields allow invalid states

questions.explanation: validate inputs in constructors and mutation methods. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of static?

options.text: use static for stateless utilities and the main entry point
static code cannot directly use instance fields without an object

questions.explanation: use static for stateless utilities and the main entry point. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of List?

options.text: use ArrayList as a common resizable sequence
removing during enhanced iteration can cause concurrent modification

questions.explanation: use ArrayList as a common resizable sequence. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of Map?

options.text: check absence explicitly before unboxing a nullable result
get on a missing key commonly returns null

questions.explanation: check absence explicitly before unboxing a nullable result. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.

questions.prompt: Which is the most reliable beginner application of Set?

options.text: use HashSet for membership and duplicate removal
Set does not provide positional indexing

questions.explanation: use HashSet for membership and duplicate removal. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.
